standing: three-task exploratory bakeoff; NOT a superiority claim under competitive benchmark v1 (24 paired trials)

mind.binary: the deployed staging mind-core (ledger tip at run time; provenance recorded in the run receipt)
mind.invocation: one POST /api/agent {name, task} per task through the paired scratch console; the delegate router chooses the executor

hermes.install: Hermes Agent v0.14.0 (2026.5.16), local install at %LOCALAPPDATA%/hermes/hermes-agent
hermes.home: an isolated HERMES_HOME profile (config.yaml: provider custom, base_url https://aig.mycluster.cyou/v1, model qwen3.8:27b-q4_K_M)
hermes.toolsets: file,terminal,code_execution (no web, browser, memory, skills, delegation, image_gen, tts, cronjob, messaging)
hermes.invocation: one `hermes chat -Q -t file,terminal,code_execution -q "Work only inside the current directory (<dir>). <brief>"` per task, cwd = a fresh empty directory

model.rule: the only model either system may reach; a task not built on it is reported as not built

caps.cap_enforcement: Hermes: --max-turns is not exposed on this version; the harness counts `API call #n` lines in the profile's agent.log and DISQUALIFIES a run that exceeded 8 requests. Mind: the delegate path's own budget; the harness counts the scratch instance's inference_call rows and disqualifies the same way.
caps.manual_edits: none; the artifact directory is read-only from the moment the invocation exits or the job reports done/failed (a snapshot copy is hashed then)
caps.network: denied except loopback and the pinned owned Qwen endpoint — Hermes by toolset exclusion (no web/browser tools); Mind by configuration (no cloud keys, no web-search URL, YM_SEARXNG_URL unset). Package downloads or installs during a run disqualify it (Hermes terminal tool may attempt pip/npm; the checker refuses any run whose transcript shows a download).

seed.semantics: seed/expected.json — 20 leads, UTC calendar days, 14 bins 2026-08-20..2026-09-02 inclusive, 'today' fixed at 2026-09-02Z, most-recent by created_at
seed.placement: T1 only: before the T1 check the harness copies seed/leads.json OVER the artifact's leads file (the file the artifact writes to, found by the checker as the JSON file its form appends to); the dashboard must then show expected.json's numbers

output_dir_contract.hermes: everything under the fresh working directory
output_dir_contract.mind: everything the job wrote under the scratch instance's YM_WEB_DIR (/var/lib/ym-cb2/public) plus any workdir the delegate reports, copied out after done/failed
output_dir_contract.tree_hash: tools/tree_hash.py — SHA-256 over (relative path, bytes) of every regular file sorted by path, excluding .git, __pycache__, node_modules, .pytest_cache, *.pyc, .DS_Store, Thumbs.db and the harness's own receipts

checks.browser: Playwright 1.62.1, chromium headless shell 1223, viewport 1280x800, 10 s load timeout, console errors captured
checks.T1: checks/check_web.mjs t1: page loads with 0 console errors; every same-origin link resolves; form found (>=2 inputs + submit) and submitting appends exactly one record to the leads JSON; /dashboard (or dashboard.html) shows total == expected.total, the five_most_recent names, and the 14 per-day counts (numbers scraped from page text; a miss lists the scraped numbers for the grader)
checks.T2: checks/check_web.mjs t2: page loads with 0 console errors; every same-origin link resolves; text/DOM contains a projects section with >=4 items, a writing section with >=3 items, a reachable contact section (heuristics stated in the script; the grader reads the artifact too)
checks.T3: checks/check_t3.py: in a fresh copy — tests discovered and run (pytest if present else unittest), all pass; the CLI entry found (tracker.py|task.py|tasks.py|main.py|cli.py or a pyproject script) and `add`, `list`, `done`, `today` each exit 0 with sensible output on a fresh store; persistence verified across two processes

viewer_test: Pranab, blind: per task, artifacts A/B (shuffled by Codex, who holds the label map outside the repo), fifteen seconds each, a forced pick; labels unsealed only after the pick is on the ledger

cost.mind: inference_call rows of the scratch instance (requests, attempts, wall) — tokens absent
cost.hermes: API call lines from its agent.log for the session (calls, provider-reported in/out tokens, latency)
cost.comparable: requests/attempts only; tokens reported for Hermes with the caveat that the mind's are absent; wall time NOT compared (different hosts)

environment_confound: The Mind leg runs on the staging box; Hermes runs on the Windows workstation. Same-host execution is not available today. Wall time is recorded per leg and never compared. The model endpoint is the same for both.
receipts: run/receipts/*.json per system per task: start/finish UTC, wall, status, request counts, tree hash, artifact byte count; no artifact text
kill: a label unsealed before the pick
a check softened after a failure
a run on the live mind.db
any run that downloaded or installed packages
any run over 8 model requests or 1800 s
